author: Flashgitz
description:
Grimboar catches up with the Reclaimer Squad on their brutal train journey through War World... or so Captain thinks. The contents of that flag are completely fabricated! Unfortunately for Captain, Hatemonger and Bryce aren't there to witness his impressive takedown. So petty...

Episode: SPACE KING 5 - WAR WORLD
title: Did anyone SEE that?!
